newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks steady in mid-week trading.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks steady in mid-week trading.

text.p: Cyprus stocks remained steady in mid-week trading on Wednesday, closing 0.53 percent lower after making gains of one percent when the market opened on Monday.
The 41-share Cyprus Stock Exchange CSE index closed on Wednesday at 84.03 points from 84.48 on Friday.

The market opened on a bull run on Monday with gains of 1.01 percent, closing at 85.33 points, the highest mark seen on the market this month. It lost 0.84 percent on Tuesday and 0.69 percent on Wednesday.
Losses were recorded in the banking, insurance and tourist enterprises sub indices.
The banking sub-index closed at 91.51, almost unchanged from Friday's 91.61.

Fully-paid shares of the Bank of Cyprus closed at 347.5, shedding one cent from the closing price of 348.5 on Friday. Fully-paid shares in the Cyprus Popular Bank added one cent, closing at 325.5. Hellenic Bank fully-paid shares added three cents to close at 259.5.
Sub indices of tourism enterprises and the insurance sector took a hammering. Insurance companies' sub index fell to 60.97 from 62.75 on Friday. Tourist enterprises fell by 2.53 percent to 73.41.
